# Website template attribution

`academic-project.css` is from [Academic Project Page Template](https://github.com/eliahuhorwitz/Academic-project-page-template), retrieved from the published template on 2026-10-17. The template is based on [Nerfies](https://nerfies.github.io/) and licensed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

The FORGE page adapts the publication header and section layout, retains Times typography, and uses local overrides in `../project.css`. Attribution is displayed in the page footer.

`bulma.min.css` is the template's bundled Bulma stylesheet. Its MIT license notice is preserved in the file header.
